_doc: Mapping table for the parity runner (see README.md, section 'ui_map.json'). Keys are logical names used in the scripts; values say how each program finds the element. Entries with null are known but not yet located - a step using them is logged as 'unmapped'.

view_defaults._doc: view switches set before a step after one was toggled and after every opened test file (Firepixel's defaults of a fresh document; the reference program keeps them across documents). Key = JS API name without get/set.

menu_bar._doc: orig: menu bar entries, centre in client coordinates of the main window (the bar is custom drawn, no UI Automation). fp: found by text.

panels._doc: panel id (with or without 'window.' prefix, '-' and '_' equivalent) -> fp panel command, German title (orig window title / fp tab text), orig menu path to show it.

tools._doc: fp tool id -> orig: {"window_rel": [x, y]} = click on the toolbox button (client coordinates, window 1600x1000 at 0,0, toolbox docked left), or a shortcut key string, or {"jsf": ...}. Tools hidden in a flyout: {"flyout": target, "orig_index": i} = press-and-hold the group button, click entry i (RUN-6). Single-key shortcuts proved unreliable in the reference program (only some reach it), so clicks are used.

tool.freeform._doc: R-24 (TW-164): through the flyout (entry 0) - the slot shows the group tool used last (Path Scrubber after tool-path-reshape/06, 07); read back by name

commands._doc: fp command id -> orig menu path ('A > B > C'), used by the verb 'command' on the orig side. fp uses ui_action {run}.
commands.modify.mergeDown: Modifizieren > Mit darunter liegender auf eine Ebene reduzieren
commands.modify.selectiveJpeg.saveSelectionAsJpeg: Modifizieren > Selektives JPEG > Auswahl als JPEG-Maske speichern

targets._doc: logical ui key -> {orig: locator, fp: locator}. orig locators: {panel, rel:[x,y]} (offset from the panel window's top-left), {window_rel:[x,y]} (client of main window), {child:{title,class,index}, panel?}, {dialog_child:{title,class,index}}, {label:'text'}. fp locators: {find:'text', role?, exact?, panel?, index?}, {window_rel:[x,y]}, {canvas:[x,y]}. A missing side or null = unmapped.
targets.dialog.field.<i>: pattern, built in: orig = i-th Win32 Edit in the open dialog, fp = i-th text_input (top-to-bottom, left-to-right); also dialog.combo.<i> (ComboBox / combo_box), dialog.check.<i>, dialog.button.<i>

Measured in the run-11 images (offsets inside the shot of `area`)
